segments.he: מוֹדֶה רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא כּוּ׳ וְאִם סָפֵק.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabbi Akiva concedes» that one does not bring payment for his misuse of consecrated property until it becomes known to him that he is guilty of misuse, as then he brings a definite guilt offering with his payment. Rabbi Tarfon said: One brings payment for misuse and its additional payment of one-fifth, and a guilt offering worth two sela, and says: If it is certain that I misused consecrated property, this is payment for my misuse and this is my definite guilt offering. «And if» it is «uncertain» whether I misused consecrated property, the money is a contribution to the Temple fund for the purchase of communal offerings and the guilt offering is provisional.
